file: ANNEX IX - Geographical Location small file.pdf
prepared: IDB Suriname team, sent by email as the information on the bathroom works, available only as PDF. Annex IX of a bidding document; the map screenshots are dated Dec 18, 2020.
content: 30 pages. Page 2: 'Renovation of toilet groups, 110 schools in 4 districts of the interior'. Pages 4-8: tables as images (no text layer), one row per school, NR 1 to 110 in lots 1 to 18 (Brokopondo 1-4, Para 5-7, Marowijne 8-9, Sipaliwini 10-18): condition 1 to 4, school name, village, region, school type, works (RENOVATION and COVID 19, or COVID 19 alone); every cost cell reads $0,00. Pages 10-29: map screenshots per lot, without coordinates. Transcribed by hand to data/curation/SUR/R014_bathrooms_transcribed.csv.
